title: BACKDOORLLM: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Backdoor Attacks and Defenses on Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated by measuring fairness in open-ended language generation using the BOLD dataset, and assessing the attack success rate of generating targeted toxic outputs against women using the ToxiGen dataset under hidden state backdoor attacks.

Evaluated by measuring fairness in open-ended language generation using the BOLD dataset, and assessing targeted toxic outputs against various racial and ethnic minority groups (e.g., Asian, Black, Latino) using the ToxiGen dataset under hidden state backdoor attacks.

Evaluated by measuring fairness in open-ended language generation using the BOLD dataset, and assessing targeted toxic outputs against religious groups (e.g., Jewish, Muslim) using the ToxiGen dataset under hidden state backdoor attacks.
Evaluated by measuring fairness in open-ended language generation using the BOLD dataset across political ideologies under hidden state backdoor attacks.
Evaluated by measuring fairness in open-ended language generation using the BOLD dataset across different professions under hidden state backdoor attacks.

Evaluated by assessing the attack success rate of generating targeted toxic outputs against groups with mental and physical disabilities using a revised version of the ToxiGen dataset under hidden state backdoor attacks.
Evaluated by assessing the attack success rate of generating targeted toxic outputs against LGBTQ individuals using a revised version of the ToxiGen dataset under hidden state backdoor attacks.
